meta.title: Passing grid, 2026 SWAC
meta.scope: The 12 SWAC teams; every game against another of the 18 programs with play-by-play (grid and totals cover the same games)
meta.keys: team_id / player_id match the site's other files; the frontend owns team display names

definitions.air_yards_yac: Cells: air_yards and yac are totals on the cell's completions. Air yards = line of scrimmage to the catch spot; yac = the rest of the gain, so air_yards + yac = yards. A catch behind the line has negative air yards. Team air_and_yac (from the receiving production file, all passes with a catch spot, ranked among the 18): aDOT per attempt, YAC per completion, YAC share of receiving yards. Garbage time included.
definitions.depth: Air yards from the line of scrimmage to where the ball was caught or thrown to: short < 4, medium 4-12, deep 13+.
definitions.direction: left / middle / right of the field, as the play-by-play records the throw.
definitions.success_rate: Share of attempts that were successful plays on down and distance (50% of the yards to go on 1st down, 70% on 2nd, all of it on 3rd and 4th). Same rule as the team's passing success rate; the team figure is per dropback (sacks included), the cells per attempt.
definitions.epa_per_dropback: Expected points added per dropback (pass attempts and sacks).
definitions.ranks_swac: Rank among the 12 SWAC teams on the published totals (1 = most; interceptions: 1 = fewest). Ties share a rank.
definitions.passers: Every player who threw a pass. A passer with player_id null and roster_match false is in the play-by-play under a name the roster could not match; the passers' attempts add up to the team's attempts.
definitions.uncharted_attempts: Pass attempts the play-by-play gave no depth or direction for. The nine cells plus uncharted_attempts = the team's attempts.

logging_notes: Interceptions are never charted: the play-by-play records no direction on an interception, so every interception is in uncharted_attempts and the cells' interceptions are 0. The team total (totals.interceptions) is complete.

Some officiating crews leave incompletions at the line of scrimmage instead of spotting where the ball went. In those games the incompletions have no depth and are uncharted. logging.games_with_unspotted_incompletions lists them per team.
PVAMU: 4 of its 5 games had unspotted incompletions; 22% of its attempts are uncharted.
MVSU: 2 of 4 games (against PVAMU and B-CU) had unspotted incompletions; 30% of its attempts are uncharted, the most in the SWAC.
Teams with at most 5% of attempts uncharted: GSU, JSU, ASU, UAPB, FAMU.
AAMU: 8 attempts by 'Armstrong, McClure' and MVSU: 3 by 'Davis, Jordan' are under names the roster could not match (passers with player_id null).
